recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-14173 does not require a current source edit; any future comparison-group categorization change should be handled under a new BRR decision.
issue_request: FHIR-14173 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core BRR request to rename ResearchStudy Arm.code to Arm.type because the element described the kind of arm rather than the arm itself.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-14173, but historical R4 source defines ResearchStudy.arm.type and the R3/R4 StructureMap maps arm code to type, matching the Jira resolution that the change was made for the Dec 2017 FHIR ballot.
additional_context: Later decisions changed the surrounding model: FHIR-31681 renamed arm to comparisonGroup, and FHIR-48736/FHIR-46491 reshaped comparisonGroup and removed comparisonGroup.type. The related FHIR-31681 reconciliation is already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current active ResearchStudy source has comparisonGroup children targetNumber, actualNumber, eligibility, observedGroup, name, and description, with no active Arm.code, arm.type, or comparisonGroup.type source element to fix.
